set -euo pipefail
cd /app
printf 'qemu-system-x86_64: '; command -v qemu-system-x86_64 || true
printf 'nginx: '; command -v nginx || true
printf 'qemu-img: '; command -v qemu-img || true
printf 'file: '; command -v file || true
printf 'ss: '; command -v ss || true
printf 'image info:\n'
file /app/isos/win311.img || true
printf '\nqemu-img info:\n'
qemu-img info /app/isos/win311.img || true
